keywords: The Petitioners sought the intervention of this Court to compel the Respondents to take the necessary actions to repair the seepage and leakage of water from the floor and walls of the Petitioners’ premises. Held – the Respondents have a statutory duty to effect the repairs owed to the Petitioners and the rest of the residents in the building. Writs issued.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
